commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano), whose effort would probably have ended in the roof of the net.
90+7' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
90+6' Hugo Rincon (Girona) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. A free kick to Rayo Vallecano.
90+4' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+3' The current number of shots on goal is 3:5.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 1 - 1 Viktor Tsygankov takes over corner duties and expertly finds Cristhian Stuani (Girona), who scores with a header that bounces up off the ground and goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
90' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nobel Mendy comes onto the pitch so that Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) can be given a rest.
88' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
86' 1 - 0 Goal! Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:0.
85' Here's the change. Fran Beltran leaves the pitch and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
83' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Fran Beltran (Girona). Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a free kick.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Unai Lopez.
79' Shots on target – 2:4.
76' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
76' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.

76' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) looks like he will send a long ball into the penalty box from the free kick and it is a good chance for one of his teammates who is good in the air to get on the scoresheet.
72' Hugo Rincon (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Arnau Martinez.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
69' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
69' Alex Moreno (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Girona will take a corner kick.
68' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Jorge de Frutos will be replaced by Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano).
68' It will be a substitution. Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to enter the pitch as Sergio Camello walks off.

66' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle as Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Free kick. Rayo Vallecano will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
65' Booking. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a caution from the referee.
65' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) takes the corner which is cleared.
65' Alex Moreno (Girona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Corner kick. Girona will have an opportunity.
63' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga comes off his line to gather the ball.
62' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
60' Michel prepares a substitution. Azzedine Ounahi is replaced by Ivan Martin (Girona).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Claudio Echeverri (Girona) replaces Thomas Lemar.
58' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Pedro Diaz.
58' The substitution is prepared. Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fran Perez.
57' Fran Beltran (Girona) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Augusto Batalla has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
57' Referee Guillermo Cuadra signals NO PENALTY for Girona after a VAR review!
56' Referee Guillermo Cuadra makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Girona. Let’s see what happens!
56' Surely that's handball by one of the Rayo Vallecano players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
55' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
53' Great teamplay by Girona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
51' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

50' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from near the penalty spot wasn't accurate at all and the ball went way wide of the right post. What a miss that is! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
48' A cross into the box from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
46' Neat passing move from Rayo Vallecano in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Paulo Gazzaniga anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.
44' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
43' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to release Andrei Ratiu with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
42' Rayo Vallecano enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
41' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

41' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rayo Vallecano.
39' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but the ball goes narrowly over the bar.

39' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick has been awarded to Girona.

38' Augusto Batalla makes a brilliant save! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!

36' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) latches onto a lofted pass from Fran Perez on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
36' Half-chance! Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) plays a pass into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga reacts well to snuff out the attack.
35' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
33' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
30' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
26' Rayo Vallecano keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
24' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
21' The resulting corner from Thomas Lemar (Girona) is cleared by the defence.
21' Joel Roca (Girona) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.

19' Rayo Vallecano hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
18' The corner from Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared away by the defence.
16' 42:58 – the latest ball possession ratio.
13' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

13' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Thomas Lemar (Girona) swings in a cross from the corner, but Augusto Batalla reads it well and gathers the ball.
11' The ball is cleared after Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Girona.
9' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

7' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rayo Vallecano.
4' The resulting corner from Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
4' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
2' Girona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The match has just started.
